description: He wears a cream long tunic beneath a muted plum-purple open-front coat with broad sleeves and narrow gold-toned geometric woven trim along the opening, cuffs and hem. A plain brown leather belt with a brass-colored buckle secures the waist, with small decorated metal fittings on its hanging tail. Brown trousers and dark brown leather boots are visible below the knee-length layers. The coat fabric has a textured woven appearance and the undertunic looks lighter and linen-like, though precise fibers are uncertain. The outfit covers torso and limbs completely with simple prosperous tailoring. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
